tools.name: generate_image_tool
tools.description: Generates an image based on the provided description and saves it with the specified file name. The image description should be detailed to ensure the resulting image matches the desired subject and surroundings; otherwise, these aspects will be chosen randomly. This function is not intended for generating images from textual data.

desc.description: A single string that provides a detailed description of the desired image. For example, 'a sunset over the mountains with a lake in the foreground'.

file_name.description: The name of the file to which the generated image will be saved. It should include the file extension, such as 'image.png'.

tools.name: tts_tool
tools.description: Converts the provided text content to speech and saves the resulting audio to a file. This function is intended for voice narration and should be used accordingly.

content.description: The text content that needs to be converted to speech.

speaker.description: The voice to be used for the text-to-speech conversion.

file_name.description: The name of the file to save the audio output without the extension. If left empty, a default name will be generated based on the content.

tools.name: write_markdown_tool
tools.description: Writes the provided content to a Markdown (.md) file on the disk. This function should be used when there is a need to persist text data in Markdown format as a result of a user action or a process that requires saving information in a structured text file.

content.description: The Markdown formatted text content to be written to the file.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the Markdown content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

tools.name: write_html_tool
tools.description: Writes an HTML file to disk with the given content. Ensures HTML tags within the content are properly closed. This function should be used when there is a need to save HTML content to a file as part of a 'save' operation.

content.description: The HTML content to be written to the file. Must contain valid HTML structure.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the HTML content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

tools.name: search_web_tool
tools.description: Executes a search query using the DuckDuckGo search engine and returns a specified number of search results from a given source.

query.description: The search term or phrase to be queried.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. A positive integer.

source.description: The source from which the search results should be fetched.

tools.name: get_url_content
tools.description: Scrapes the specified URL for textual data and returns the content as a string. This function is useful for extracting information from web pages when a URL is provided.

url.description: The web address of the page to scrape. It should be a valid URL format, such as 'http://www.example.com'.

timeout.description: The maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, with a default value that allows for a reasonable amount of time for most web pages to load.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent string to be used for the HTTP request to simulate a particular browser, which is optional. Some websites may require this for access.

gauges.name: exec
gauges.trigger: material with a Python function and call arguments; the call runs in a sealed sandbox and the one candidate equal to its value is released

gauges.name: tool-call
gauges.trigger: material with tool definitions and options that are JSON tool calls; calls to missing tools or malformed calls are ruled out, schema and grounding findings are shown to the reads

gauges.name: state
gauges.trigger: entities with ids in the material and options written as `id.prop becomes value`; no-op changes are ruled out and after-state questions are derived from the chosen change

gauges.name: preference
gauges.trigger: a rated history of color palettes and two candidate palettes; five fits of the user's own history release an answer when all agree

gauges.name: calculator
gauges.trigger: quantitative questions in rows of up to four questions; the model writes a setup and exact arithmetic is shown to its thought
